gotchas.text: MTP speculative decoding from the checkpoint's own drafter, num_speculative_tokens=4 (5 tokens per verify step, ~4.2 committed at p~0.9/step on this workload). Decode numbers include the speculative speedup; compare only against cells with the same speculative setting.

compilation mode 0 (fully eager body, no torch.compile/inductor) with cudagraph_mode=FULL requested; the engine auto-downgraded to FULL_DECODE_ONLY because the Qwen3.8 QSA attention backend only supports uniform-batch graphs. Plain non-eager boots die ~36s into the inductor phase on GB10; mode 0 skips inductor and survives.

Image: local/vllm-openai:qwen38-flash-next-ray2.57.0 = stock vllm/vllm-openai:qwen38-flash-next + ray 2.57.0 (stock image has no ray; two-node TP needs it) + ple_patch.py (checkpoint stores the 51B PLE n-gram table as global-scale FP8 but the stock loader only registers that quant method under Fp8Config). VLLM_MARLIN_USE_ATOMIC_ADD=1 on both ranks - without it NVFP4-Marlin on SM121 races to silently wrong output.

MTP depth is constrained by the QSA ring capacity assert: capacity = 4*ceil((4+k)/4) must divide the attention block size 1616, so legal num_speculative_tokens are 1-4 and 9-12; k=5-8 cannot boot on this architecture.

provenance.notes: Attach mode: engine already running (ray cluster, API server inside the ray-head container). Two DGX Sparks (GB10/SM121, 128 GB unified each) as TP=2 over a direct CX7 200G RoCE link, one GPU per node, ~76 GB of weights per rank; harness ran on the head node. Box otherwise idle. Kernel 6.17.0-1031-nvidia, driver 580.173.02.
